messages:
jake_h: FYI legal flagged a request: auditors want an exportable timeline of routing-policy changes that includes who changed what, the justification text, and an immutable signature. need a proposal for console + API UX.

olivia_pm: ack. do we have a current place where we store 'justification' for policy edits? I thought we only had actor + diff + timestamp.

maria_sre: correct — DB stores actor, payload, and diff blobs, but no freeform justification field. we do keep audit_event.reason in some places (sparse).

jake_h: proposal: add required `justification` (max 1k chars) for any change that affects routing/quota/tenant-mappings. surface it in console changeflyout and include in exports.

sam_infra: DB-wise ok, but implications: retention + PII. if justifications contain emails/ids, export rules must redact. we should add `redaction_mode` param to the API: `redact=none|hash|mask` and default to `hash` for NDJSON exports.

olivia_pm: for the console: show reason inline in the timeline row, allow collapse, and add a quick "download proof" that packages the diff + metadata + signature as a signed bundle. UX question: should we require reason for canaries/rollbacks too?

jake_h: yes require on any config write that hits routing/quotas. For rollbacks maybe allow shorter reason but still mandatory.

maria_sre: telemetry: we'll need an event kpi for "missing_justification_attempts" so product can see how many users try to submit empty reasons (and fail).

sam_infra: signature: we can HSM-sign a canonicalized JSON line for each audit entry. proto: `audit_v1` with fields (ts, actor, resource, op, diff_sha256, justification_hash). then sign. export format: NDJSON where each line is canonical JSON + signature header.

olivia_pm: example API shape draft: `GET /api/v1/audit?resource_type=routing_policy&after=2024-01-01T00:00:00Z&format=ndjson&redact=hash&include_signatures=true`

jake_h: + include `actor_resolution=full|id_only` to control whether we expand service accounts to names. legal requested full names but we need opt-in.

legal_bot: note: auditors will ask for chain-of-custody. a signed NDJSON + S3 object signed URL with access logs should be fine. retention needs to be >= 7 years for some customers.

sam_infra: storage/ops cost: full retention + signatures + diffs for 7 years is non-trivial. suggest tiered retention: default 1 year, enterprise opt-in for 7y. add export-sampling option for lower tiers (sample_rate param).

maria_sre: sampling complicates compliance — need to make it explicit in export metadata if samples were used. also we must ensure routed fallback logs (automatic policy fallbacks) are recorded as separate events.

jake_h: UI copy: show a badge on timeline items: `signed` or `sampled` and a hover tooltip explains.

olivia_pm: pagination and UX: NDJSON can be huge. in console we should allow date-range + actor filter + diff-search (text) and preview first 100 rows, then "request archive" to pipeline S3 export.

sam_infra: implement server-side streaming export job. job lifecycle: queued -> running -> ready-with-url. emit job webhooks and console notification.

maria_sre: on API debate: should `include_diff=true` default to false? diffs are the heavy part. exports for audits probably want diffs, but normal list queries can default to false.

jake_h: default false. add `preserve_diff_in_archive=true` for archive jobs.

olivia_pm: accessibility: in console diff viewer show inline color-coded add/remove, and provide a text-only download for auditors.

sam_infra: compatibility note: older consumers expect `actor` to be an id. if we add `actor_name` make it optional to avoid breaking.

maria_sre: QA checklist: 1) require justification on UI/API writes 2) enforce redaction modes on export 3) sign each exported record 4) job lifecycle + telemetry 5) retention tiers 6) sample metadata on exports.

jake_h: can someone draft the API RFC? include a sample NDJSON line, signing spec, and console mock. olivia do you want to own the mocks?

olivia_pm: I can take the mocks and the console copy. sam and maria can own infra/schema and ops. I'll open an RFC doc later today.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: audit-service v2.3.0 -> staging (sha: ab12cdef) :rocket:

sam_infra: quick note: add migration to backfill `justification` = "n/a" for old events and mark them `legacy=true` so export consumers know.

maria_sre: + add a small lambda to scrub PII on old justifications when customers opt for `redact=mask`.

jake_h: thanks all. olivia, tag me on the RFC. we'll present at next eng-platform sync. :thumbsup:
